author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: U.S. banks suffered widespread outages, disrupting online banking and payments and raising concerns about technology dependencies and resilience. A wave of service disruptions affected several major U.S. banks on Monday, November 16, leaving customers unable to access online banking, check account balances or complete financial transactions. The problems also affected digital payments, including Zelle, raising […]
title: U.S. Banks Struggle With Outages Amid Wider Technology Disruptions

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Google finds attackers using autonomous AI agents to automate exploits, steal AI access and scale intrusions, often sacrificing stealth for speed. Google’s Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) says attackers have moved past typing prompts into a chatbot. They now run autonomous, multi-agent frameworks such as ARTEX, CAIRN, CyberStrikeAI and PentAGI to carry out multi-stage intrusions faster. […]
title: Google GTIG Warns AI Agents Automate Exploits, Steal Credentials and Scale Cybercrime

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Cognitive warfare uses AI, deepfakes and fear to manipulate opinions, erode trust and disrupt society. Contemporary warfare is no longer fought solely through armies, weapons, and technological infrastructure. Alongside military operations and cyberattacks, a new dimension of conflict is emerging in which the primary target is people’s ability to interpret reality, distinguish reliable information from […]
title: Cognitive warfare: the new battlefield is the human mind

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: The researcher MalwareMustDie released an open ARTEX detection pack in seven formats, built on behavior and a repeatable playbook, because attackers now turn weeks into hours. The researcher MalwareMustDie released a public detection pack for ARTEX, the open-source AI pentest framework that criminals now run against real targets. He published it quickly because campaigns built […]
title: From Report to Tested Detection in Hours: The ARTEX Signature Pack

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Amazon spotted AI agents running on ARTEX steal AI credentials and test deepfake ID bypasses. Amazon’s threat intelligence team published findings on criminals running offensive campaigns with ARTEX, an open-source agentic AI penetration testing framework. Between 3 October and 5 November, Amazon’s MadPot network of decoy sensors caught requests from ARTEX agents. Some sensors posed […]
title: ARTEX: How Cybercriminals Use AI Agents to Scale Their Attacks

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: German drone maker Quantum Systems confirms a cyberattack that disrupted operations, with reports pointing to a malicious software update. Quantum Systems, a German defense company that builds reconnaissance and interceptor drones and the software that controls them, confirmed an incident in late October. The company says its security teams quickly contained the threat while working […]
title: German Military Grounds Quantum Systems Drones Following Reported Cyberattack

author: Pierluigi Paganini
description: Researchers uncover two threat groups, SilentAir and LIMINAL PANDA, exploiting mobile networks to spy on users and intercept calls and text messages. Telecom security firm Enea published research on two threat actors, dubbed SilentAir and LIMINAL PANDA, working inside mobile networks. According to the experts, SilentAir has compromised operators since before 2025; however, a link […]
title: SilentAir and LIMINAL PANDA Target Telecom Networks to Spy on Subscribers
